== Description ==

[[Benji Chu]] (right, black SWCCG cap, Team Albany tee, teal glasses, name tag), [[Phil Aasen]] (left, grey flat cap, beard, black jacket, looking at a card), and [[Barry Alperstein]] (background right, olive Mordor tee, at the next table) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
